title: Smallest Ticket Chain
commonMistakes: Popping the largest destination because the adjacency list was sorted in the wrong direction
Returning the postorder without reversing it
Collapsing duplicate tickets into a single edge
Committing to a greedy walk that gets stuck while unused tickets remain
followUps: How would the answer change if the starting airport were not fixed?
What is the result when no Eulerian trail exists?
How would you adapt the algorithm to report the largest valid itinerary instead?
